message: Independent frozen review f45718409cb4f9b3d3e96e3353e4c9af of exact f45718409... = ChangesRequested. Reviewer2 verified initial queued OpenTab epoch+final host/window guards, but discovered two new concrete async authorization defects. P1: executeJs and captureDom both permit post-opt-out JS/DOM injection if user disables agent-created tabs while awaited assess/preflight is in progress. Must revalidate current opt-in, relevant host permission, connection/epoch/tab ownership immediately before irreversible injection and fail closed. See findings/opt-out-assess-injection.md. P2: OpenTab opt-out during its first async host permission assessment is silently dropped, producing timeout/uncertain outcome rather than a definite rejection response. See findings/open-revocation-silent-timeout.md. Add deterministic negatives for all three and precise error classification; preserve one-send-only uncertainty where actual dispatch possible. No broad redesign, no deployment; .NET 11 Release/Node, exact fresh frozen review.
